Data:Salon.past.quiet.json.label: A Quiet Salon
Data:Salon.past.quiet.json.desc: You held a quiet Salon - perhaps there weren't very many guests, or they didn't have much to say. [This is a marker to remind you that you can't hold another Salon until next Season.]

Data:Salon.past.sombre.json.label: A Sombre Salon
Data:Salon.past.sombre.json.desc: You held a sombre Salon where no-one had much to say about anything. [This is a marker to remind you that you can't hold another Salon until next Season.]

Data:Salon.physic.json.label: A Picnic in the Physic Garden
Data:Salon.physic.json.desc: The peace of flowers, the murmur of leaves. [Here one might have a Picnic, but only in Spring or Summer.]

slots.label: Secretary Persistent
slots.description: In Hush House, an empty place is often traditionally left at table for Rowena, protectress of Hush House, and once Secretary Persistent of the Curia of the Isle. [If you one day propose a successor for Rowena... seat them here.]
